visual_findings: Scanner RGB order is plausible in both. Breast/adipose TCGA-S3-AA11-01Z-00-DX1_5 has sparse nuclei whose virtual DAPI is visibly brighter than much of the surrounding tissue; its local spatial AUCs on sufficient regions are all at least 0.618, but global AUC 0.689, shell contrast 0.047 and edge/core nuclear intensity ratio 0.555 fail the predeclared gates. This is a borderline image worth blinded QC-adjudication study, not an automatic override. Prostate TCGA-G9-6356-01Z-00-DX1_4 shows diffuse virtual DAPI and protein signal; nuclear contrast 0.045 fails and it remains excluded. Neither field has marker-specific ground truth.
scope: Preview-scale inspection of cases 65-66 from an active 93-case CPU bundle. No test-label-guided QC threshold changes.
